frame: x right, y depth toward the user (0 = back edge), z up (0 = underside); origin back-left-bottom; boxes on the nominal 8 mm grid (real parts 0.1 mm smaller/side); studs (dia 4.8, 1.7 tall) on top of every non-tile part

steps.1: Base: big plates over the whole footprint (studs up). This is what rests on the desk.
steps.2: Second plate layer over the whole footprint; its seams cross the base's seams.
steps.3: Brick course (3 plates) leaving the two 13x13-stud pad cavities and the cable channels to the back edge.
steps.4: Plate layer on the bricks, same holes. Its studs round each cavity are what the 8x16 floor tiles grip.
steps.5: Fit the pads: foam on the cavity floor, pad on the foam (micro-USB edge toward the channel), cable out the back.
steps.6: Charging floor: 8x16 tiles over each pad (2 for the keyboard, 1 for the mouse), gripping the studs round the cavity.
steps.7: Rest of the floor layer: black tiles in the pockets, plates under the walls (they tie the floor tiles in).
steps.8: First wall course (bricks) round the pockets.
steps.9: Second wall course, joints crossing the first.
steps.10: Top tiles: Light Bluish Gray ring round the pockets, Dark Bluish Gray elsewhere.
